$comment: One entry per provider. versions lists every version this site serves, latest last -- the committed list, not a live release-list query per repo per build (UBI-240: a build that queries live lists produces different output depending on when it runs). Adding a version is a one-line change, visible in review. repo is the real GitHub repo the docs release lives on; each version's own release tag is a bare vX.Y.Z on that repo, distinct from its sdk/go/vX.Y.Z module tag.
